criteria.text: Export wordCount(text), counting whitespace-separated words and returning 0 for empty or whitespace-only text.
shout(text) trims leading and trailing whitespace before upper-casing.

tests.label: acceptance
tests.name: wordCount counts words separated by mixed whitespace

tests.label: acceptance
tests.name: wordCount returns zero for empty and whitespace-only text
